notes.title: A Big Event + A New Look
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2][p]The [b]ECS Team[/b] here with some exciting news as we continue working on Drunkonauts and prepare for our demo launch!
[/p][h2][/h2][h2]We're part of the Steam Debut Festival![/h2][p]We’re proud to announce that [b]Drunkonauts[/b] is participating in the [b]Steam Debut Festival[/b]!

The event starts today, August 7, and features a collection of upcoming games from new developers around the world, including ours.

We’re grateful for the opportunity to share Drunkonauts with even more players!

You’ll be able to explore our [b]newly updated Steam page[/b] and, if you haven’t already, [b]wishlist the game[/b] to stay updated on the demo and launch.  [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/75e2ee0611cecac6211c7b10c85ea1cf4e191801.png"][/img][/p][h2][/h2][p][/p][h2]A fresh new look for our Steam Page[/h2][p]To celebrate our participation in the festival, we’ve completely revamped the [b]Drunkonauts[/b] Steam page!

The new design includes updated visuals, an improved description, better preview images, everything we had before, but better.

It's the same chaotic game, just with a page that better reflects its personality. So make sure to check it out!

notes.title: Demo & Trailer Updates
notes.content:
[h2]Let's talk about some serious stuff[/h2][p]
Hey everyone! Enchanted Crafts Studios team here, with a quick status update as we continue developing Drunkonauts and get closer to releasing the gameplay trailer and [b]Steam Demo[/b].

We've been working hard on many parts of the game; new maps, weapons, jetpacks, items, and game modes. You will see many of them soon in the trailer!



We also want to share some news about how we’ll continue building the community and collecting feedback after the Steam demo goes live.

We’re preparing [b]playtest sessions[/b] that will include [b]exclusive content[/b] not available in the Steam demo. These playtests will help us see how new ideas and gameplay elements perform before they are fully added to the game. They will only be available to a small group of players at a time.

To help this process, we’re also launching an [b]official Discord server[/b], where players can hang out, give feedback, and join future community events.

[b]Both the playtests and the Discord server will go live after the Steam demo is released.[/b]



If you want to be part of the first wave of playtesters or get notified when Discord opens, we recommend to [url="https://ecsgames.eo.page/community-newsletter"][b]subscribe to our newsletter[/b][/url][b]  [/b]💌



[/p][h2]🎮 TL;DR: what to expect[/h2][list][*][p]A more polished Steam demo compared to the Itch.io version[/p][/*][*][p]Playtest sessions with exclusive content not in the Steam demo[/p][/*][*][p]A new community Discord server launching after the Steam demo

notes.title: DID YOU KNOW? - JETPACKS 101
notes.content:
[h2][b]JETPACKS 101[/b][/h2][p]In [b]Drunkonauts[/b], jetpacks aren’t optional. They’re your [b]best friend[/b] and [b]worst idea[/b] at the same time.
Jetpacks help you escape danger, surprise your friends, and fly in style. 😎[/p][p]Fly above traps, confuse your friends, or make a fast getaway.[/p][p][/p][p]New Jetpack styles, same chaos.
Choose your favorite👇[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/c2b533897fce8f8c0acf13a293b6c4875cd10ef8.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Soaper[/b][/h3][p][b]Squeaky clean chaos. 🫧[/b]
[b]Fun? Always.[/b]
🫧 Blows soap bubbles instead of flames.
✨ Style points: 10/10.
🫣 Dignity points: 0/10.
No one takes you seriously. That’s the point.
Perfect for players who want to annoy friends and confuse enemies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586596/df2180dd792007cf95365b34c344d3b0619c6e72.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Turbo Fan[/b][/h3][p]Big fan energy. Literally.
🌀 Giant fan engine on your back.
🚀 Makes take-offs look like rocket launches.
🔊 Extra loud and extra dramatic.
The subtle option? Never heard of it.
Friends will hear you before they see you.
This one is for astronauts who want all eyes on them.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]In Drunkonauts, style is half the battle.[/b][/h3][p]Whether you’re keeping it squeaky clean with [b]The Soaper[/b] or going extra loud with [b]The Turbo Fan[/b], your jetpack says a lot about how you fight.[/p][p][/p][p]Turbo Fan or Bubble Jetpack? Pick your poison.
💨 [b]Turbo Fan[/b] — Loud, powerful, impossible to ignore.
🫧 [b]Bubble Jetpack[/b] — Silly, soapy, just plain fun.[/p][p][/p][p]🚀 Stay tuned for more deep dives into the weird and wonderful world of [b]Drunkonauts[/b].
And don't forget to wishlist on Steam! 👇[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603900/Drunkonauts/?utm_source=steamPosts"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🚀 How You Can Help Right Now[/b][/h2][list][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603900/Drunkonauts/?utm_source=steamPosts"]Wishlist on Steam[/url] to tell Steam you want more chaos.[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://nebula-dev.itch.io/drunkonauts"]Play the Itch demo[/url] and drop feedback, bugs & memes in the comments![/p][/*][*][p][url="https://ecsgames.eo.page/community-newsletter"]Join our Newsletter[/url] to be the first to find out about features and see WIP content and art.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]One click. That’s it. Thank you![/i] 💜[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]With love,[/b][/p][p][b]The Enchanted Crafts Studios Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Early Demo LIVE on Itch — Steam Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Drunkonauts Demo Is Live – Come Break Physics With Us & Shape the Steam Release[/h1]

Hello, explorers! We’re [i]Enchanted Crafts Studios[/i] and we’re teaming up with [i]Nebula Developers Lab[/i] to bring you [b]Drunkonauts[/b] — a chaotic multiplayer party brawler with hilarious physics-based combat!

[h2]✨ What’s New [/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Public early demo launched on Itch — April 25 2025[/b]  
Test-fly the jetpacks, throw around bottles of beer and hit your friends with crazy space weapons
[*][b]Top community notes so far[/b]
"No visible indicator for the jetpack's cooldown" → Jetpack cooldown meter
"Hard to grab knocked down enemies" → Easier grab on rag-dolled foes  
"Knock down timer increases too drastically"→ A timer more balanced for more “down but not out” moments
[/list]
[h2]🔨 What We’re Building Next[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Late June 2025 — Official Steam Demo[/b]
[list]
[*] All the features from the early demo — [i]enhanced[/i]  
[*] More customization options — hats, jetpacks, accessories, you name it!
[*] Smoother onboarding — create or join lobbies to easily play with your friends
[*] Better multiplayer connection — never miss a punch or a throw because of "lag" 😉
[/list]
[*][b]1.0 Launch[/b] — TBD — [i]quality before calendar[/i]  
[/list]
